text:
maria: heads up — we've been seeing sporadic packet drops and huge east-west p99 on many GPU jobs in eu-west-1 since ~08:30 UTC. jobs try to talk ipv6 between pods and then things time out. noticed a bunch of retransmits in the app logs :frowning:

alex: can you paste a tcpdump/traceroute? are these only on gpu nodes or also on cpu workers?

maria: only on GPU node pool so far (gpu-pool-eu-west-1). quick tcpdump from one of the affected pods:
```
# tcpdump -n -i eth0 ip6
14:02:12.123456 IP6 fe80::a1->fd00:10::23: ICMP6, time exceeded in-transit
14:02:12.123457 IP6 fd00:10::23 > fd00:10::45: UDP, length 1296
14:02:12.123458 IP6 fd00:10::45 > fd00:10::23: UDP, length 1280
# lots of fragments and some MTU related ICMP6
```
seems like large UDP/encapsulated packets are being fragmented and we get ICMPv6 PTB/TTl messages back.

tom_ops: ack. I saw a bunch of 'packet too big' logs on the top-of-rack switches as well. Could be a mismatch in vxlan/encap mtu between racks after the k8s upgrade yesterday.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-318-42 — high pod-to-pod packet loss in gpu-pool-eu-west-1 (severity: p2)

alex: can you run `ip -6 route` and `ip -6 neigh` on one of the affected nodes? also check the CNI config (we pushed a new CNI v0.11.2 yesterday)

maria: pasted outputs:
```
# ip -6 route show
fd00:10::/64 dev eth0  proto kernel  metric 256
fe80::/64 dev eth0  proto kernel  metric 1024
# ip -6 neigh show
fd00:10::23 lladdr aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff STALE
fd00:10::45 lladdr cc:dd:ee:ff:11:22 REACHABLE
```
CNI config: vxlan encap, mtu 1450 (we set to 1450 for vxlan overhead). Some nodes report mtu 1500 on the interface; mismatch.

natalie: could be asymmetic pathing — I remember a routing change where we started advertising pod CIDs from the host-level v6 route table and also from a proxied network agent. double-ads can cause replies to take a different path (encap vs raw) and drop due to MTU differences.

tom_ops: okay quick mitigation: scaling down new CNI daemonset to previous revision across gpu nodes in the cluster. rolling back to v0.11.1 in the gpu-pool now. also temporarily set kube-proxy to prefer ipv4 for service clusterIP to avoid ipv6 data plane for heavy jobs.

alex: good. after rollback, can someone run an end-to-end iperf6/tracepath6 between two gpu pods? looking for consistent MTU / no ICMP6 PTB.

maria: running iperf6 now — before rollback: lots of retransmits, max segment ~1200. after rollback in progress, first pod pair shows:
```
# tracepath6 fd00:10::45
 1?: [LOCALHOST]    pmtu 1500
 1:  fd00:10::1                                         0.123 ms
 2:  fd00:10::45                                        0.456 ms
```
iperf6 shows stable throughput ~80% expected, retransmits dropped.

sre-bot: update: INC-2026-318-42 status -> mitigated, rollback applied to gpu-pool-eu-west-1 at 08:54 UTC.

natalie: follow-ups: we need a postmortem to cover why CNI release matrix didn't catch differing MTU default on some hosts, add a canary that runs ipv6 large-packet e2e tests, and add a kubelet host-level sanity check for mount/iface MTU vs CNI configured MTU.

alex: +1. also add explicit RDMA path validation for dual-stack setups — some of our RDMA-capable nodes were hitting different encap paths and we risk losing RoCE flow consistency.

maria: logging ticket details in INC and will draft postmortem. thanks for the quick rollback everyone :thumbsup:
